definitions.gloss: light blocking; shading; shielding from light
definitions.explanation: The act of blocking or shutting out light, or the property of doing so. Used for curtains, blinds, lenses, and other materials that prevent light from passing through.

examples.japanese: {遮光|しゃこう}⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}めた→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遮光|しゃこう}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This room has high light-blocking properties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦フィルム→フィルム：02951_firumu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遮光|しゃこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}して→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please store photographic film in a light-shielded environment.

notes:
Refers to blocking or shielding from light. Very commonly seen as a modifier in compound terms for products and materials.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遮光|しゃこう}⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧ — blackout curtain
- {遮光|しゃこう}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ — light-blocking property
- {遮光|しゃこう}⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧ — tinted/shaded lens
- {遮光|しゃこう}⟦フィルム→フィルム：02951_firumu⟧ — light-blocking film
- {遮光|しゃこう}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ — light-blocking rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遮断|しゃだん}→遮断：15673_shadan⟧ — blocking, shutting off (broader; used for sound, electricity, etc.)
